name: Back-projection
aliases: Back-projection — Adjoint Backprojection, Adjoint Projection, Cone Beam Adjoint, FDK Backprojection (CPU/PyTorch Path), Radon backprojection (parallel), xrt_adjoint
definition: Computes 2D/3D back-projections by mapping projection weights to volume expansion coefficients. It is the adjoint of the forward projection operator `xrt_apply()`.
summary: Back-projection scatters 2D projection data into 3D space as the adjoint of forward projection, distinguishing itself by redistributing ray integrals along geometric paths to reconstruct volume representations.
